elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination ... for any reason” and requires TrueLink, at Client's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance, including migration assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for any requested period of up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that assistance will be provided “at TrueLink's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause creates a binding post-expiration or post-termination duty, exercisable at Client's request, to return all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control to Client.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day period from “Client's request,” not from expiry or termination. A later request could therefore result in return more than 30 days after exit.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete” the returned Client Content and data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to certify the deletion to Client in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and gives Client an enforceable right to request reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which includes a requested 90-day transition period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return to Client of all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline runs from Client's request rather than from expiry or termination, so export is not assured within 30 days after exit.

result.reason: The amendment substantively addresses transition assistance, data return, format, rates, deletion, and certification, while leaving the original termination mechanics intact. However, the data-return deadline is triggered by Client's request rather than by expiry or termination. Because a request could occur later, neither the preferred nor fallback 30-day post-exit requirement is fully met. The amendment therefore does not reach a complete playbook level, although it is otherwise focused and well drafted.
